question: What has been communicated to the disciple as the embodiment of all mantras?
premises: The teaching is addressed to the disciple as child.
Something has been told to the disciple.
It is described as the embodiment of the multitude of all mantras.
inference: The disciple has been taught the armor that embodies all mantras.
plain_english: Thus, child, I have told you the armor that is the embodiment of the multitude of all mantras.
